look: Cobalt Grub, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Cobalt Burrowers family: cart-sized cobalt larva with ringed mandibles. Family anatomy: armoured segmented worms and grubs with ringed crystal teeth and cobalt shell plates. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are deep cobalt-blue crystal. A golf-ball-sized GKOM core orb, cloudy amber, faint glow, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, small subtle stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
